subject: Crystallize Claw
text: Crystallize Claw is the 77th floor boss weak to blunt attacks with a recommended combat power of 760 Pts that drops Duel Glove as its Last Attack bonus.

evidence.quote: Floor...Boss | クリスタライズクロウ...○打属性攻撃に弱い！...撃破推奨戦力値 760 Pts...Last Attack | デュエルグラブ

subject: Madness Horn
text: Madness Horn is the 78th floor boss weak to slash attacks with a recommended combat power of 775 Pts that drops Luna Talisman as its Last Attack bonus.

evidence.quote: Floor...Boss | マッドネスホーン...○斬属性攻撃に弱い！...○斧技はパリィで回避可！...○腕の破壊で斧技を封印！...撃破推奨戦力値 775 Pts...Last Attack | ルナタリスマン

subject: Tri-Tempest
text: Tri-Tempest is the 79th floor boss that inflicts paralysis and stun, drops Duel Vest as its Last Attack reward, and has its all-target attack sealed by destroying its right neck.

evidence.quote: Floor...Boss | トライテンペスト...○麻痺&スタンを使用...○右首の破壊で全体攻撃を封印！...Last Attack | デュエルベスト

subject: Guilty Scythe
text: Guilty Scythe is the 80th floor boss weak to blunt attacks that awards 2200 EXP and 790000 Col and drops Hyper Ring as its Last Attack bonus.

evidence.quote: Floor...Boss | ギルティーサイス | EXP 2200...790000col...○打属性攻撃に弱い！...Last Attack | ハイパーリング

subject: Grand Legacy
text: Grand Legacy is the 82nd floor boss weak to blunt attacks with a recommended combat power of 835 Pts that drops Virtus as its Last Attack bonus.

evidence.quote: Floor...Boss | グランドレガシー...○打属性攻撃に弱い！...○パンチ攻撃は退避で回避可！...○核の破壊で無敵技を封印！...撃破推奨戦力値 835Pts...Last Attack |  ウィルトゥース

subject: Last Attack Bonus
text: Defeating a floor boss rewards special equipment as a Last Attack bonus, which must be struck by Kirito himself or it can basically never be obtained again.

evidence.quote: 原作同様、本作においても階層ボスにトドメを刺すとLAボーナスとして特殊な装備品が手に入る。...LAはキリトさん本人でなければダメで、[パートナー](//w.atwiki.jp/sao-im/pages/58.html "パートナー \(4656d\)")や攻略組に持っていかれると（基本的に）二度と入手できない。
evidence.translation: Just like the original work, defeating a floor boss in this game rewards special equipment as a Last Attack bonus... The LA must be done by Kirito himself, and if taken by a partner or the assault team, it can basically never be obtained again.

subject: Floor Boss
text: When near death, floor bosses repeatedly unleash the omnidirectional knockback special attack Limit Liberalization.

evidence.quote: 階層ボスは瀕死になると全方位ノックバックの特殊技“リミットリベライゼーション”を連発してくるので、これにいかに対処するかがカギ。
evidence.translation: When a floor boss is near death, it repeatedly unleashes the omnidirectional knockback special attack Limit Liberalization, so dealing with this is key.

subject: Bunshin Battle Skills
text: Using a battle skill with the Bunshin clone effect allows dodging all incoming attacks several times.

evidence.quote: 「分身」の効果をもつ[バトルスキル](//w.atwiki.jp/sao-im/pages/55.html "バトルスキル \(3587d\)")を使うと、数回あらゆる攻撃を躱すことができる。
evidence.translation: Using a battle skill with the Bunshin clone effect allows dodging all incoming attacks several times.

subject: Secret Sword Skills
text: Secret art sword skills require 600 or 800 weapon skill value to learn and darken the screen so no attacks occur, dramatically lowering the difficulty of getting the LA.

evidence.quote: また、説明欄に「奥義」とあるソードスキルは、発動後は画面が暗転、この間は一切の味方・敵の攻撃が発生しない。...習得には600ないし800の武器スキル値を要求され、全て◇系（発動が遅く被ダメで潰される）、消費SPも多いが、使えればLA取得の難易度は劇的に下がる。
evidence.translation: Furthermore, sword skills described as secret arts darken the screen after activation, during which no ally or enemy attacks occur... Learning them requires 600 or 800 weapon skill value, and while they are slow and consume much SP, using them dramatically lowers the difficulty of getting the LA.

subject: Floor Boss Victory Rank
text: Floor boss evaluation criteria are damage dealt, damage taken, action disruption, and zero casualties as an absolute condition, with clear time not mattering.

evidence.quote: 評価基準は与ダメージ量、被ダメージ量、行動阻害、戦死者の4つ。実はクリア時間は関係ない。...戦死者：一人も出さないのが絶対条件
evidence.translation: The evaluation criteria are four: damage dealt, damage taken, action disruption, and casualties. Clear time actually does not matter... Casualties: having zero casualties is an absolute condition.

subject: Lizardman Monarch
text: Against Lizardman Monarch in Greed Hole, the unparriable area skill of spear wielders is a threat, so target spear lizardmen first.

evidence.quote: ＜貪欲なる坑窟＞リザードマンモナーク...パリングできない槍持ちの範囲スキルが脅威なので、まずは槍リザードマンから狙っていこう。
evidence.translation: <Greed Hole> Lizardman Monarch... The unparriable area skill of spear wielders is a threat, so target spear lizardmen first.

subject: Ragneck
text: Ragneck in Poison-Woven Forest drops Cloth Boots on the first defeat.

evidence.quote: ＜毒織りの森＞ラグネック...足防具 | クロスブーツ（初回）
evidence.translation: <Poison-Woven Forest> Ragneck... Footwear | Cloth Boots (first time)

subject: Crimson Spinner
text: Crimson Spinner in Predator's Pilgrimage has 2 HP bars and drops an exceptional 150,000 Col.

evidence.quote: ＜捕食者の巡礼路＞クリムゾンスピナー...HPゲージが2本あり、長期戦必須。...15万という破格のColを落としてくれるので、なにか買いたいものがある場合は（少々遠いが）通ってもいい。
evidence.translation: <Predator's Pilgrimage> Crimson Spinner... It has 2 HP gauges and requires a long battle... It drops an exceptional 150,000 Col, so if you want to buy something you can farm it.

subject: Ghastly Gaze
text: Ghastly Gaze has a recommended combat power of 745 Pts and gives Rage Ring as its Last Attack bonus.

evidence.quote: ＜フロアボス＞ガストレイゲイズ...撃破推奨戦力値 745 Pts...ラストアタック | レイジリング
evidence.translation: <Floor Boss> Ghastly Gaze... Recommended combat power 745 Pts... Last Attack | Rage Ring

subject: Ghastly Gaze
text: Ghastly Gaze is weak to thrust attacks, and destroying its tentacles and eyes seals the corresponding powerful area attacks.

evidence.quote: ○突属性攻撃に弱い！...触手と眼が破壊可能で、破壊すれば対応した強力な範囲攻撃を封印できる。
evidence.translation: Weak to thrust attacks!... Tentacles and eyes can be destroyed, and destroying them seals the corresponding powerful area attack.

subject: Overlay Slime
text: Overlay Slime in Sky-Facing Serpent Tail resists blunt attacks, is vulnerable to slash attacks, and its Mucus breath can be nullified with Airy Shield.

evidence.quote: NM | オーバーレイスライム...出現エリア 空臨む蛇の尻尾...打属性の攻撃が通りづらいので、斬属性で戦うとよい。...粘液はブレス扱いで、避ける以外に[バトルスキル](//w.atwiki.jp/sao-im/pages/55.html "バトルスキル \(3587d\)")のエアリーシールドでも無効化できる。
evidence.translation: NM | Overlay Slime... Spawn Area: Sky-Facing Serpent Tail... Blunt attacks are ineffective, so fighting with slash attribute is recommended... Mucus counts as a breath attack and can be nullified with the Airy Shield battle skill.

subject: Goblin Leader
text: Goblin Leader in Sneering Ogres' Cave is accompanied by 2 bow goblins that chip away HP and should be defeated first.

evidence.quote: NM | ゴブリンリーダー...出現エリア 嘲笑いし鬼達の洞穴...2匹のお供はどちらも弓ゴブリンで、放っておくとチクチクと削られ続けるのが若干うざい。...先に倒してしまおう。
evidence.translation: NM | Goblin Leader... Spawn Area: Sneering Ogres' Cave... Its 2 companions are both bow goblins, which chip away HP if left alone... Defeat them first.

subject: Treant Dominator
text: Treant Dominator in Wild Fighting Demons' Clearing has 2 adds that can be pulled with throwing knives without linking to reduce their numbers beforehand.

evidence.quote: SNM | トレントドミネイター...出現エリア 荒ぶる戦鬼達の開拓地...取り巻き2匹は感知されるギリギリの所から投げナイフでリンクさせずに釣れるので、あらかじめ数を減らしておく。
evidence.translation: SNM | Treant Dominator... Spawn Area: Wild Fighting Demons' Clearing... 2 of the adds can be pulled with throwing knives without linking, so reduce their numbers beforehand.

subject: Fat Slime
text: In Crawling Fool's Corridor, fighting the 2 linked Fat Slimes is easier by removing shields so evasion can occur and focusing on evasion equipment and battle skills.

evidence.quote: NM | ファットスライム...出現エリア 地這う愚者の回廊...少し進んだファットスライムが2匹いる小部屋では確実にリンクするため、攻撃速度の相乗効果で厳しい戦いになる。...盾装備だと仕様上回避が発生しないので、片手武器でも盾はあえて外し、...回避重視の装備と[バトルスキル](//w.atwiki.jp/sao-im/pages/55.html "バトルスキル \(3587d\)")構成にした方がいくらか戦いやすいだろう。
evidence.translation: NM | Fat Slime... Spawn Area: Crawling Fool's Corridor... In the room further ahead with 2 Fat Slimes they will link, making it a tough battle... Since evasion cannot occur when a shield is equipped, removing the shield even for one-handed weapons and focusing on evasion equipment and battle skills makes fighting easier.

subject: Orc General
text: Orc General is an NM whose spawn area is Demon-Conceiving Cave.

evidence.quote: NM | オークジェネラル...出現エリア 魔を孕む石窟
evidence.translation: NM | Orc General... Spawn Area: Demon-Conceiving Cave

subject: Flare Dragon
text: Flare Dragon is an NM whose spawn area is Abyss Forest Road.

evidence.quote: NM | フレアドラゴン...出現エリア 深淵へ届く林道
evidence.translation: NM | Flare Dragon... Spawn Area: Abyss Forest Road

subject: Madness Horn
text: Madness Horn has slow attack motions easily parried with parry, bash, and onslaught, but Lumberjack has a high chance of instant death from full HP.

evidence.quote: 攻撃モーションは遅く、パリング余裕でしたの噛ませ牛である。...パリング・バッシュ・スロートの3点セットに回復系結晶を用意しておけば楽勝だろう。...特にランバージャックは満タンから即死の可能性も結構高い。
evidence.translation: Its attack motion is slow, easily parried... Having the 3-set of parry, bash, and onslaught along with recovery crystals makes it an easy victory... In particular, Lumberjack has a high chance of instant death even from full HP.

subject: Tri-Tempest
object: Flame of Purification and Paralysis Removal Crystals
text: Tri-Tempest frequently uses a wide-angle short-range area attack with paralysis debuff when HP decreases, making Flame of Purification and Paralysis Removal Crystals essential items.

evidence.quote: HPが減ると麻痺デバフのついた広射角・短射程・扇型の範囲攻撃を乱発してくる。...そうでなくとも浄化の炎や消痺結晶は必需品。
evidence.translation: When HP decreases, it frequently unleashes a wide-angle short-range fan-shaped area attack with paralysis debuff... Flame of Purification and Paralysis Removal Crystals are essential items.

subject: Guilty Scythe
text: Guilty Scythe requires Scale Mantle for paralysis resistance and Flame of Purification, while its area attacks must be avoided by unlocking target and escaping with a dash.

evidence.quote: 先に言っておくと今回も麻痺対策と浄化の炎が必須。現時点ではスケイルマントに麻痺耐性が付いているので用意しよう。...まず退避で回避可というのは、タゲを解除してダッシュで逃げろと言うこと。バックステップやすり足ではまず間に合わない。
evidence.translation: Paralysis countermeasures and Flame of Purification are essential. Scale Mantle has paralysis resistance at this point, so prepare it... Evading by retreating means unlocking target and escaping with a dash, as backstepping will not make it in time.

subject: Dark Knight
text: Dark Knight is weak to blunt attacks, has a recommended combat power of 820Pts, and drops Blood Necklace as its Last Attack bonus.

evidence.quote: Boss | ダークナイト...○打属性攻撃に弱い！...撃破推奨戦力値 820Pts...Last Attack | ブラッドネックレス
evidence.translation: Boss | Dark Knight... Weak to blunt attacks!... Recommended combat power 820Pts... Last Attack | Blood Necklace

subject: Dark Knight
text: Dark Knight's Lightning can cause instant death to raid members if 1 set hits directly, and its Infinity Guard makes all attacks miss so bash and onslaught are ineffective.

evidence.quote: 特にライトニングが1セット直撃した場合、攻略組はまず即死する。...従って戦死者を出さない場合、攻略組狙いのライトニングは発動してからでもいいので絶対に止めること。...瀕死時に使うインフィニティガードは受ける攻撃がすべて「miss」になる。「ダメージ0」ではないのでバッシュやスロートも無効になる。
evidence.translation: In particular, if 1 set of Lightning hits directly, raid members will instantly die... Therefore to prevent casualties, absolutely interrupt Lightning aimed at raid members even after activation... The Infinity Guard used near death makes all attacks miss, and since it is not damage 0, bash and onslaught are also ineffective.

subject: Hollow Avatar
text: In the 1st Battle against Hollow Avatar, unlike on the 98th floor, getting the LA drops the genuine Dark Repulser.

evidence.quote: #### 第1戦ホロウアバター...茅場がデスゲーム宣言の際に使用した、あの空洞のGM用アバター。...注意点を挙げるならば、98層時と異なり、LAを取ると本物のダークリパルサーを落とす。...Last Attack |  ダークリパルサー
evidence.translation: 1st Battle Hollow Avatar... That hollow GM avatar used by Kayaba during the death game declaration... Unlike on the 98th floor, getting the LA drops the genuine Dark Repulser... Last Attack | Dark Repulser

subject: MHCP Prototype Units 3 to 9
text: The 7 MHCP units equip daggers or one-handed swords with units 8 and 9 using stronger skills, so prepare party-targeted recovery and clone skills for the next 3rd battle.

evidence.quote: 装備は短剣か[片手剣](//w.atwiki.jp/sao-im/pages/26.html "片手剣 \(3573d\)")、ソードスキルはスウィーブやデルタアタックなど細剣カテゴリのものを使用する。8号と9号の使用スキルが他より強め。...問題は7体というその数で、運悪く複数にタゲられた仲間はジワジワとHPが削られていってしまう。...特に戦死ゼロを目指している場合、またはラストバトルモードでクラインが参戦している場合は次の3戦目が最大にして最後の鬼門となるので...パーティ対象の回復・分身スキルは付けられるだけつけておこう。
evidence.translation: Equipped with daggers or one-handed swords, they use rapier category sword skills like Sweep and Delta Attack, with units 8 and 9 having stronger skills... The problem is their number of 7 units, where allies targeted by multiples have HP chipped away... Especially when aiming for zero casualties or if Klein joins, the next 3rd battle is the final hurdle, so equip as many party-targeted recovery and clone skills as possible.

subject: Hollow Strea
text: Hollow Strea is fixed to the wall and uses powerful area attacks that can be nullified with Protection Seal, or stabilized by gifting Blood Necklaces to all participating raid members.

evidence.quote: #### 第3戦 ホロウストレア...攻撃傾向はただひとつ、強力な範囲攻撃の連発による力押しのみ。...しかし、その一つ一つが極めて高い威力を持つ上、通常攻撃まで範囲攻撃になっている。そして、最大の脅威が壁際に座標が固定されている事。...また、ドミニオンホロウなど一部の技はプロテクションシールで無効可。...参加する攻略組全員にブラットネックレスをプレゼントして自分は遠くから奥義を連発することで演出中に回復するため安定する。
evidence.translation: 3rd Battle Hollow Strea... Her attack style is simply pushing with consecutive powerful area attacks... Each attack has extremely high power, and even normal attacks are area attacks, with the greatest threat being that her coordinates are fixed to the wall... Also, some moves like Dominion Hollow can be nullified with Protection Seal... Gifting Blood Necklaces to all participating raid members and firing secret arts from afar stabilizes the fight as they recover during the cutscene.
